answer: Each new agent must publish a fresh secure-enclave quote whose measurement hash is a one-time nullifier, plus an admission proof whose zero-bit work rises with join velocity. Intake then behaves like karst: scripted clones pool in one cheap oasis and never reach a separate dune of hardware. An attacker who wants a thousand earning identities must buy or rent a thousand distinct attested devices and re-mine a harder proof for every head, a hardware-plus-delay bill that exceeds one epoch's pool share before kinship checks zero the cluster.
